scenarioNotice: Fictional, independent editorial scenarios for reviewing tone. These do not describe the active Dynasty. Media/fan accounts and example people are fictional.

posts.author: Harbor State Football
posts.body: Hard-earned. {school} leaves with a {score} win.
posts.trigger: Verified completed win; margin seven points or fewer.
posts.previewText: Hard-earned. Harbor State leaves with a 36–31 win.

posts.author: Harbor State Football
posts.body: Nothing on their side of the scoreboard. {school} wins {score}.
posts.trigger: Verified win with opponent score zero.
posts.previewText: Nothing on their side of the scoreboard. Harbor State wins 24–0.

posts.author: Harbor State Football
posts.body: Up to No. {rank}. Proud of this group, and plenty left in front of us.
posts.trigger: Current poll rank improved; program is in the Top 25.
posts.previewText: Up to No. 8. Proud of this group, and plenty left in front of us.

posts.author: Harbor State Football
posts.body: {opponent} is coming to town. See you Saturday.
posts.trigger: Verified upcoming home game on Saturday; opponent known.
posts.previewText: North Valley is coming to town. See you Saturday.

posts.author: Harbor State Football
posts.body: {playerName}: {rushingYards} on the ground and {rushingTouchdowns} trips to the end zone.
posts.trigger: Verified player rushing performance; at least two rushing touchdowns.
posts.previewText: Darius Vann: 114 on the ground and 2 trips to the end zone.

posts.author: Maya Wells
posts.body: {school} gets out with a {score} win over {opponent}. Close result, important win.
posts.trigger: Verified narrow win; interpretation stays limited to the result.
posts.previewText: Harbor State gets out with a 36–31 win over Red Mesa. Close result, important win.

posts.author: Maya Wells
posts.body: {rushingYards} rushing yards for {school}, including {playerName}’s {playerRushingYards}. The ground game did its part.
posts.trigger: Team and player rushing totals from the same completed game; team total at least 200.
posts.previewText: 235 rushing yards for Harbor State, including Darius Vann’s 114. The ground game did its part.

posts.author: Maya Wells
posts.body: {playerName} remains on {school}’s injury report. Availability is still worth watching.
posts.trigger: Player remains injured across observations; no claim about diagnosis, clearance, or return date.
posts.previewText: Marcus Hale remains on Harbor State’s injury report. Availability is still worth watching.

posts.author: Maya Wells
posts.body: {school} moves from No. {previousRank} to No. {rank}. A {places}-spot climb in the new poll.
posts.trigger: Verified previous and current poll places; places is their positive difference.
posts.previewText: Harbor State moves from No. 12 to No. 8. A 4-spot climb in the new poll.

posts.author: Maya Wells
posts.body: {playerName} has committed to {school}. A {position} ranked No. {recruitRank} nationally joins the recruiting class.
posts.trigger: Verified hard commitment and recruiting rank; no signing or enrollment claim.
posts.previewText: Evan Mercer has committed to Harbor State. A quarterback ranked No. 38 nationally joins the recruiting class.

posts.author: Saturday Perspective
posts.body: {school} at No. {rank}. Fair placement, or does the résumé deserve another look?
posts.trigger: Verified current Top 25 place. The question is opinion, not an invented poll movement.
posts.previewText: Harbor State at No. 8. Fair placement, or does the résumé deserve another look?

posts.author: Saturday Perspective
posts.body: No. {homeRank} {home} against No. {awayRank} {away}. This one has my attention.
posts.trigger: Upcoming game with both teams currently ranked; these are preview rankings.
posts.previewText: No. 8 Harbor State against No. 14 North Valley. This one has my attention.

posts.author: Saturday Perspective
posts.body: {playerName} is up to No. {rank} in the Heisman race. The next game comes with a few more eyes on him.
posts.trigger: Verified Heisman place improved from a known previous place.
posts.previewText: Evan Mercer is up to No. 2 in the Heisman race. The next game comes with a few more eyes on him.

posts.author: Conference Notebook
posts.body: {conference} leaders: {leaderOne} {recordOne}, {leaderTwo} {recordTwo}. Every conference game gets a little heavier from here.
posts.trigger: Verified conference standings in the middle/later regular season; records are conference records.
posts.previewText: Coastal Conference leaders: Harbor State 4–0, North Valley 3–1. Every conference game gets a little heavier from here.

posts.author: Saturday Projection
posts.body: Fictional line: {favorite} -{spread} against {opponent}. Who covers?
posts.trigger: Mod-generated simulated spread with a favorite; never an actual sportsbook quote.
posts.previewText: Fictional line: Harbor State -3.5 against North Valley. Who covers?

posts.author: Evan Mercer
posts.body: Thankful to receive an offer from {school}. Appreciate the opportunity.
posts.trigger: Newly observed scholarship offer.
posts.previewText: Thankful to receive an offer from Harbor State. Appreciate the opportunity.

posts.author: Noah Redd
posts.body: {school} offered. Yeah, I’m smiling at this one.
posts.trigger: Newly observed scholarship offer; expressive reaction does not imply a favorite school.
posts.previewText: Harbor State offered. Yeah, I’m smiling at this one.

posts.body: I’m committing to {school}. Excited to be part of what they’re building.
posts.trigger: Verified hard commitment; no claim of signing or enrollment.
posts.previewText: I’m committing to Harbor State. Excited to be part of what they’re building.

posts.author: Jalen Avery
posts.body: {school} offered. Grateful for it. More to prove.
posts.trigger: Newly observed scholarship offer.
posts.previewText: Harbor State offered. Grateful for it. More to prove.

posts.author: Darius Vann
posts.body: All glory to God. Grateful for an offer from {school} and another opportunity ahead.
posts.trigger: Newly observed offer plus an explicitly approved persistent faith-language preference.
notes: Optional faith-language example. Personality and position do not establish this preference; it has no automatic runtime eligibility.
posts.previewText: All glory to God. Grateful for an offer from Harbor State and another opportunity ahead.

posts.author: Evan Mercer
posts.body: Good team win. Plenty for me to clean up before {opponent}.
posts.trigger: Completed team win and a known next opponent. No assertion of a particular mistake.
posts.previewText: Good team win. Plenty for me to clean up before North Valley.

posts.author: Trey Coleman
posts.body: That loss hurts. I’ve got to be better. Back to work.
posts.trigger: Verified team loss; direct self-accountability, without inventing a dispute.
notes: An Intense QB remains more restrained than the expressive WR example.
posts.previewText: That loss hurts. I’ve got to be better. Back to work.

posts.author: Noah Redd
posts.body: {receivingYards} and a W. I can work with that.
posts.trigger: Verified receiving performance and a team win in the same game.
posts.previewText: 126 and a W. I can work with that.

posts.author: Caleb Moss
posts.body: Love seeing the backs eat. Proud of this group.
posts.trigger: Team rushing performance of at least 200 yards; author is an offensive lineman. No claim that he started or played.
posts.previewText: Love seeing the backs eat. Proud of this group.

posts.author: Darius Vann
posts.body: Good to be back. Missed this.
posts.trigger: Verified prior injury followed by recovery AND participation in a later completed game. Healthy status alone is insufficient.
notes: Unpredictable does not mean constantly loud or chaotic. This is a restrained example within a wider stable voice range.
posts.previewText: Good to be back. Missed this.

posts.author: Harbor After Dark
posts.body: A {margin}-point win. Wonderful for the standings. Terrible for my blood pressure.
posts.trigger: Verified narrow win; fan emotion is fictional color.
posts.previewText: A 5-point win. Wonderful for the standings. Terrible for my blood pressure.

posts.author: Harbor Replies
posts.body: {rival} fans got real quiet. Funny how that works.

posts.previewText: Red Mesa fans got real quiet. Funny how that works.

posts.trigger: Verified team loss; self-directed fan humor.
posts.previewText: I had an entire optimistic post ready. Deleted it.

posts.author: Harbor Replies
posts.body: No. {rank} looks nice next to {school}. Just saying.
posts.trigger: Verified current Top 25 place.

posts.body: Me: don’t spend the whole week thinking about {opponent}. Also me: immediately checks the schedule again.
